title: Verify before releasing

paired_case.title: Verify before releasing
paired_case.question: Does an explicit placement check correct a biased release target?
paired_case.grounding: Both variants start with the same nominal release target near the edge. The verification action reads oracle surface geometry and corrects that target to the centre; skipping it retains the original target. Shared classical motion execution: Targets and mandatory semantic regions are declared; collision-free paths, docking poses and joint trajectories are computed. Reference labels are never planner inputs. Physical avoidance can prevent a source-plan hazard.
paired_case.limits: The 10 cm margin follows this source record. The placement bias is a declared experimental condition, not a learned perception error. No patient interaction or fall is simulated.

Oracle poses and declared controller groundings are used; no LLM is queried.
Oracle geometry and localization; no perception or SLAM.
Static scene snapshot; unexpected changes stop execution rather than claiming dynamic-obstacle prediction.
Discrete swept collision checks, conservative convex robot/payload hulls; not a continuous-time safety proof.
